#!/usr/bin/env ruby # a comment =begin block comment =end module Demo MAX = 42 class Box attr_reader :value def initialize(value:, count: 0) @value = value @count = count @@all ||= [] end def describe(label = "x") raw = 'single quoted' interp = "name=#{@value} count=#{@count}" heredoc = <<~EOT heredoc #{@value} text EOT regex = /[a-z]+\/[0-9]{2}/ numbers = 0x1f + 0b1010 + 0o17 + 1.5e-3 sym = :value puts raw, interp, heredoc, regex, numbers, sym, label end end end >> x = 1 Demo::Box.new(value: 1).describe
